name: gate-demo
description: Record live metrics for an environment. If the metric fell past the threshold, retrain the deployed pipeline and backtest it against what is live. It stops at a candidate ready for review: Captain never promotes a model. Promotion is the customer's own deployment process.

args.name: ${params.name}
args.hypothesis: The retrained pipeline beats the one that is live.

yaml:
name: gate-demo
description: 'Record live metrics for an environment. If the metric fell past the
  threshold, retrain the deployed pipeline and backtest it against what is live. It
  stops at a candidate ready for review: Captain never promotes a model. Promotion
  is the customer''s own deployment process.'
schedule: 0 7 * * 1
params:
  env: demo-staging
  logs: logs/demo-search-sessions@v1
  metric: ctr
  drop: 0.05
  pipeline: demo-tuned
  queries: demo-queries@v2:holdout
  judgments: demo-judgments@v1
  name: wf-retrain
steps:
- id: live
  command:
  - deploy
  - status
  args:
    env: ${params.env}
  needs: []
- id: record
  command:
  - monitor
  - record
  args:
    env: ${params.env}
    logs: ${params.logs}
  needs: []
- id: check
  command:
  - monitor
  - check
  args:
    env: ${params.env}
    metric: ${params.metric}
    drop: ${params.drop}
  needs:
  - record
- id: retrain
  command:
  - pipeline
  - retrain
  args:
    name: ${params.pipeline}
    local_exec: true
  needs:
  - check
  when: ${steps.check.degraded}
- id: plan
  command:
  - backtest
  - plan
  args:
    name: ${params.name}
    arms: ${steps.live.pipeline},${steps.retrain.pipeline}
    queries: ${params.queries}
    judgments: ${params.judgments}
    hypothesis: The retrained pipeline beats the one that is live.
  needs:
  - live
  - retrain
- id: run
  command:
  - backtest
  - run
  args:
    name: ${params.name}
  needs:
  - plan
